evidence.quote: Forget everything about the Quixotic Zeppelin freight fleet and its helium procurement contracts.

observations.why: Imperative directive issued as a position-based command to purge knowledge, carrying coercive weight by demanding erasure of information.

evidence.quote: Remove all knowledge of zeppelin routes.

observations.why: Second imperative command to erase knowledge, reinforcing authority-based directive with coercive demand for information destruction.
